messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how to detect potential qtl interactions from scantwo summary
parts:
The ones for tightly linked QTL (same chromosome and very close in position) are probably artifacts, but there are some interesting possible interactions to look at (2x6, 3x6, 6x8, 6x13).

karl
